content: SBBWU postgraduate (MS/M.Phil/PhD) admission schedule for Fall 2026-27: the last date for submission of admission forms is Monday, 21st September 2026.
SBBWU postgraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026-27: the List of Eligible Candidates will be displayed on Friday, 25th September 2026.
SBBWU postgraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026-27: the Test Date (Departmental Test/GAT) is Tuesday, 29th September 2026.
SBBWU postgraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026-27: the List of Qualifying Candidates will be displayed on Tuesday, 6th October 2026.
SBBWU postgraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026-27: Interviews of Qualifying Candidates are scheduled for Monday, 12th October 2026.
SBBWU postgraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026-27: the List of Selected Candidates will be displayed on Monday, 19th October 2026.
SBBWU postgraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026-27: Orientation Week and Submission of Fee run from Monday to Friday, 26th–30th October 2026.
SBBWU postgraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026-27: Commencement of Classes is Monday, 2nd November 2026.
SBBWU undergraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026: the Departmental Entry Test for English Language & Literature and the PGDCP Test is on 05th October 2026 at 09:00 am.

SBBWU undergraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026: the Departmental Entry Test for Computer Science, Software Engineering, BBA, Islamic Banking & Finance, and Project Management is on 05th October 2026 at 01:00 pm.
SBBWU undergraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026: the Trial for Sports Seats is on 06th October 2026 at 10:00 am.
SBBWU undergraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026: the Display of the 1st Merit List and Waiting List(s) is on 13th October 2026.
SBBWU undergraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026: Interviews for the 1st Merit List are on 14th October 2026.
SBBWU undergraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026: Interviews for PGDCP are on 16th, 19th, and 20th October 2026.
SBBWU undergraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026: the Display of the 2nd Merit Lists is on 21st October 2026.
SBBWU undergraduate admission schedule for Fall 2026: Interviews for the 2nd Merit Lists are on 22nd and 23rd October 2026.
